title: Composition variants with alternative partner packages

cases.title: Nidalee and Sivir without Malphite
cases.subject: compositions
cases.original_question: What frontline packages work with AD Nidalee and Sivir when I leave out Malphite, and which supporting units tend to change with them? I'm interested in level-eight boards without emblems.
cases.question: What frontline packages work with AD Nidalee and Sivir when I leave out Malphite, and which supporting units tend to change with them? I'm interested in level-eight boards without emblems.
cases.scenario: Final level-eight AD-oriented Nidalee and Sivir, no Malphite; ordinary emblem-free intent is retained but only named-holder/inspected-inventory exclusions can be certified publicly.
cases.plan: Declare Nidalee orientation using named exact loadouts, enforce Malphite absence, and discover alternative frontliners/support via cohort deltas and query_cohort. Verify multi-unit package conjunctions and compare their supported outcomes, with a separately labeled Malphite reference cohort.
cases.checks: Give recurring frontline/support combinations, counts and outcome tradeoffs at comparable named carry/tank investment. State which no-emblem restriction was actually verified; no equipped emblem does not imply no other trait grant. Do not substitute a historical 18.2 guide for current outcomes.
cases.limits: No guaranteed Adaptor-form field, global emblem-family predicate, complete roster signature or exact whole-board investment match. Strict emblem-free eligibility needs prepared data or exhaustive feasible exact-name exclusions.

cases.title: Yi and Kog without Rengar
cases.subject: compositions
cases.original_question: What versions of Master Yi reroll work without Rengar? I'd like to keep Kog'Maw and see how the supporting board changes around Vi or Krug as the tank.
cases.question: What versions of Master Yi reroll work without Rengar? I'd like to keep Kog'Maw and see how the supporting board changes around Vi or Krug as the tank.
cases.scenario: Itemized Master Yi plus Kog'Maw, with Rengar absent. Compare Vi-focused, Krug-focused, shared and unclear frontline investments; do not exclude one tank merely because the other is present.
cases.plan: Use named absence and Yi/Kog conditions, discover tank star/item-count/loadout patterns, then define supported focused/split roles by explicit named allocations. Compare package cohorts within Yi2/3 and common level strata; query actual companions/traits.
cases.checks: Preserve shared-tank groups and uncertain roles, report joint recurrence/counts/mean/top4/win and actual supporting units. Distinguish tank identity from greater resources or a different Yi item package.
cases.limits: Tank role is an investment proxy, not damage absorbed. Global artifact/emblem count and complete equal-budget matching are not supported filters.

cases.title: Ahri and Sett: Blossom or Executioner partners
cases.subject: compositions
cases.original_question: With Ahri and Sett on my final board, how does keeping Yorick and Karma for the Blossom package compare with using Alune and Amumu for an Executioner package? Are the results different at level eight and level nine?
cases.question: With Ahri and Sett on my final board, how does keeping Yorick and Karma for the Blossom package compare with using Alune and Amumu for an Executioner package? Are the results different at level eight and level nine?
cases.scenario: Ahri and Sett present, Yorick+Karma versus Alune+Amumu, separately at final levels eight and nine; overlap packages reported separately.
cases.plan: Resolve anchors and define exact partner pairs in compare_cohorts with shared Ahri/Sett investment and each level. Discover remaining unit and trait frequencies, verify plausible complete support conjunctions, and identify boards satisfying both pairs before calling cohorts exclusive.
cases.checks: Show all four package-by-level cells, counts and mean/top4/win/intervals where possible. Report observed remaining supports and actual Blossom/Executioner contribution differences; no label-only comparison.
cases.limits: Contains-pair conditions do not define a complete exact roster. Same level need not imply identical deployed capacity; global budget and special-state matching remain limited.

cases.title: Akali and Camille: Solar or Adaptor partners
cases.subject: compositions
cases.original_question: With Akali and Camille both three-star, how do Solar-heavy end boards compare with Adaptor-focused support packages? Which supporting units change together, and does the comparison hold when the other three-stars and artifacts are similar?
cases.question: With Akali and Camille both three-star, how do Solar-heavy end boards compare with Adaptor-focused support packages? Which supporting units change together, and does the comparison hold when the other three-stars and artifacts are similar?
cases.scenario: Akali3 and Camille3, comparing declared Solar-heavy versus Adaptor-focused support packages, preserving supporting stars and named artifact builds.
cases.plan: Discover support-unit stars/loadouts and recorded Solar/Adaptor contributions, then explicitly define joint packages and overlap. compare_cohorts compares those packages in named additional-upgrade and item strata at common levels; incomplete support upgrades remain separate observations.
cases.checks: Explain which support units change together, with counts/outcomes for both complete and incomplete named upgrade patterns. Do not cherry-pick only high-placement or fully upgraded boards and generalize to all Akali/Camille end states.
cases.limits: No generic total-three-star, total-artifact, upgraded-board-cost or observed Adaptor-form filter. Named vectors can be controlled; broader equality cannot be asserted.

cases.title: Ahri and Morgana: alternative support packages
cases.subject: compositions
cases.original_question: For Ahri–Morgana end boards, is there actually a payoff to the Alune/Lux/Taric support package compared with versions using Kog'Maw or Hecarim? I'd like a comparison at the same final level, including what fills the remaining slots.
cases.question: For Ahri–Morgana end boards, is there actually a payoff to the Alune/Lux/Taric support package compared with versions using Kog'Maw or Hecarim? I'd like a comparison at the same final level, including what fills the remaining slots.
cases.scenario: Ahri–Morgana end states with Alune/Lux/Taric versus actual Kog'Maw- or Hecarim-containing support packages at the same final level.
cases.plan: Discover remaining supports, exact carry/tank investment and resolvable Lux identities; define candidate conjunctions and report overlaps rather than presuming Kog and Hecarim alternatives are exclusive. Compare supported packages with shared named carry/level conditions.
cases.checks: Name the inspected supporting rosters or explicitly bounded cores and report counts/outcomes, including changed trait contributions. Do not use family headline totals as variant denominators. Generic Lux is a heterogeneous cohort unless an actual variant identity is available.
cases.limits: Same level is not exact board capacity; full-roster closure, global special-item exclusion and Lux choice from unrelated board traits are not supported.
